info.title: FuelLog API
info.description: Backend with identity, vehicles, fuel entries, full-tank consumption cycles and summaries. No frontend. Editing, deletion, exports, password recovery and complete account management are planned. All protected queries enforce ownership. Decimal values use strings. Consumption is null with a reason when unavailable.

put.summary: Edit an owned vehicle without replacing its identity or history
put.description: Transactional edit serialized with fuel-entry creation. model is trimmed and also updates internal nickname for existing selectors. accepted fuels govern new entries only; historical fuels and consumption metrics stay unchanged. Optional fields omitted or null become unknown (null). currentOdometerKm is an independent snapshot: it does not constrain or rewrite fuel history. Read the latest GET vehicle and send its ETag; after a 412 reload and let the user reconcile the form before resubmitting.

post.description: New entries require both GPS coordinates. Omitted tankState/historyGapBefore default to UNKNOWN/false. GPS participates in the canonical command fingerprint: reuse the original UUID and GPS snapshot on retries; changed coordinates conflict (409). Exact pre-GPS retries still return the existing entry (200), without adding coordinates. Missing GPS for a new UUID is 422; malformed numeric types/non-finite JSON values are 400; range/precision or incomplete pairs are 422. Consumption uses only valid FULL-to-FULL cycles; UNKNOWN does not create a full-tank baseline.

put.summary: Update an owned fuel entry in place
put.description: Preserves entry UUID, vehicle, owner and original creation fingerprint. Requires one strong numeric If-Match ETag from GET. Each accepted PUT advances the version, including unchanged values. Retrying with the old ETag returns 412: refetch and resolve before retrying. Original POST retries return the current edited entry without overwriting it or creating another entry. Archived vehicles may have their historical entries corrected. New fuel selections must be allowed by the vehicle; the entry current historical fuel may remain unchanged. Odometer chronology excludes this entry and validates its new date and ties. Does not modify other entries or consume a pending vehicle history gap.

parameters.description: Exactly one strong numeric ETag from GET; weak tags, lists, wildcards, signs and values outside int64 are invalid.

post.summary: Change password and revoke every session
post.description: Requires the current password and a different new password (6..128 characters). If 2FA is enabled, secondFactorCode is required and accepts TOTP or one unused recovery code. All sessions, including the current session and every refresh token, are revoked after success; the app must log in again. Credential version invalidates pending MFA setups and challenges. Never log submitted credentials.

post.summary: Prepare TOTP enrollment after password verification
post.description: Only while 2FA is disabled. Pending encrypted secret is bound to authenticated user, current session and credential version, expires after 5 minutes, and does not activate 2FA. Requires the current password on every call. Issuer FuelLog; SHA1, 6 digits, 30 seconds; 160 random secret bits. QR must be rendered locally.

Returns 10 single-use recovery codes once; only hashes are persisted.

post.description: Public only for exact POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify. Challenge is opaque, hashed at rest, single-use, valid for 5 minutes and bound to user and credential version. Accepts TOTP (SHA1/6 digits/30 seconds, at most one adjacent step, with replay protection) or one unused recovery code. Only success creates a session and issues TokenResponse. Atomic consumption under user lock prevents concurrent recovery/challenge reuse; failed password login never issues a challenge.

anyOf.description: Positive decimal string using a dot; excessive precision is rejected without silent rounding.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional odometer reading in whole km reported at vehicle creation; omitted/null means unknown, including existing vehicles. Returned unchanged by POST /vehicles and GET /vehicles or /vehicles/{vehicleId}. This is a registration snapshot, not a computed latest fuel-entry reading; fuel entries do not update it. It neither creates a consumption cycle nor constrains retroactive fuel entries. Negative values return 422; fractional, string, boolean and out-of-int64 inputs return 400.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional odometer snapshot reported at creation or replaced by PUT /vehicles/{vehicleId}; omitted/null on PUT clears it. GET and list return the persisted reading. Fuel entries do not update it; it neither creates consumption cycles nor constrains retroactive entries. Legacy creation accepts int64; edits accept safe integers 0..9007199254740991.

UpdateVehicle.description: Only these four fields are editable. model also sets nickname; legacy fields are not part of this command.

model.description: Required nonblank model after Unicode whitespace trimming.

allowedFuels.description: Required nonempty selection; null members are invalid. Changes apply to new fuel entries only.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional safe JSON integer in whole km; omitted/null clears the snapshot. Negative/unsafe integers return 422; fractional, string, boolean or out-of-int64 JSON values return 400. Independent of historical fuel readings.

tankCapacityLiters.description: Optional positive decimal string with a dot, greater than 0 and less than 100000, at most three decimal places (NUMERIC(8,3)); no rounding. Omitted/null clears capacity. Invalid values return 422; JSON numbers/booleans return 400.

tankState.description: Omitted or null defaults to UNKNOWN; never inferred as FULL. Legacy explicit values remain supported.

historyGapBefore.description: Omitted or null defaults to false. Editing does not consume a pending vehicle history gap or rewrite other records.

latitude.description: Omitted or null pair preserves stored historical coordinates. Supply both non-null numbers to replace; WGS84, at most seven meaningful decimals, no rounding.

longitude.description: Omitted or null pair preserves stored historical coordinates. Supply both non-null numbers to replace; WGS84, at most seven meaningful decimals, no rounding.

UpdateFuelEntry.description: Editable purchase fields without a client UUID. Same creation validation and 3/4/2 decimal scales apply. Omitted or null tankState defaults to UNKNOWN and historyGapBefore to false; optional text may be cleared. Omitted or null coordinate pair preserves the historical snapshot, including null for pre-GPS entries; a supplied non-null pair replaces it after the same range and precision validation. Never requires recapturing current location.

recoveryCodes.description: Shown once after enable; each contains 256 random bits, is stored only as a hash, and is single-use.
